book.name: SAN JUAN
book.title: TZOTIꞌ CꞌUL YET COLBANILE TZꞌIBN̈EBILCANO YU NAJ SAN JUAN

content: Yet istzotel Comam Jesús yeb huneꞌ ix ah Samaria
Yaben ebnaj fariseo ta chiyapaxocan̈ Comam Jesús haꞌ iswiꞌ anma yeb xin ta caw ecꞌnaxa anma tzujan yinta Comam satapaxo naj Juan;
(Waxan̈ca maẍtaj caw Comam chianican̈ haꞌ iswiꞌ anma tuꞌ, wal xin haꞌ ebnaj chicuywi yinta Comam, haꞌ ebnaj chianican̈ haꞌ iswiꞌ anma.)
Hayet yabenilo Comam Jesús ta yabe ebnaj fariseo huneꞌ tuꞌ, yel Comam yul ismajul Judea, ismeltzoto bey yul ismajul Galilea,
yajaꞌ xin, caw yilal yecꞌ Comam yul ismajul Samaria.
Yapni Comam bey huneꞌ con̈ob chiyij Sicar ayco yul ismajul Samaria tuꞌ, iscawilal huneꞌ txꞌo txꞌotxꞌ akꞌbilcano yet payat yu naj Jacob tet iscꞌahol, haꞌ ton naj José.
Haꞌ bey tuꞌ xin, ay huneꞌ cꞌuh watxꞌebil yu naj Jacob. Caw xin xasiqui Comam isbelwi, yuxin oc tzꞌon̈no Comam istiꞌ huneꞌ cꞌuh tuꞌ yet lan̈anxa yoc chuman.

Wal ebnaj chicuywi yinta Comam tuꞌ xin, to ebnaj yul con̈ob islokꞌo tzet chilolaxi. Hayet ayto ebnaj lokꞌwo tuꞌ xin, yapni huneꞌ ix ah Samaria ikꞌoti haꞌ yul huneꞌ cꞌuh tuꞌ, yalni Comam tet ix: —Akꞌ nino hawaꞌ tuꞌ wucꞌuꞌan, ẍi Comam.

Istakꞌwi ix tet Comam: —Walach hach tiꞌ, caw ah con̈ob Israel hach, ¿tom caw mach hawohtajoj tato ah con̈ob Samaria inan? ¿Tzet yin̈ chakꞌanpaxo ha haꞌ hawucꞌu wetan? ẍi ix tet Comam. (Yal ix hacaꞌ tuꞌ, yuto haꞌ anma Israel mach chischahle tzotelo isba yeb anma ah Samaria.)

Yalni Comam Jesús tet ix xin: —Kꞌinalo ta hawohta huneꞌ mac chikꞌanni haꞌ tawet tiꞌ, yeb xin ta hawohta iscꞌulal iscꞌul Comam Dios chiyakꞌ jet, chimhakꞌanpaxo hawaꞌ wetan, catmi wakꞌnihan haꞌ chiakꞌni kꞌinale machi istan̈bal tawet, ẍi Comam tet ix.
Yalnipaxo ix tet Comam: —Mamin, caw nahat yehayto haꞌ yul cꞌuh lah, caw xin machi hanet chiinahti haꞌ. ¿Bay xin chaẍto hawikꞌati haꞌ chiakꞌni kꞌinale chawakꞌ wettuꞌan hawalni?

Naj Jacob, jichmam yettax payat tiempo, haꞌ naj an̈ecano huneꞌ cꞌuh tiꞌ jetan̈. Ha haꞌ yul huneꞌ cꞌuh tiꞌ xin yucꞌ naj yeb sunil yuninal, yebpaxo sunil isnokꞌ. ¿Tom xin caw ecꞌbal hachto satapaxo naj Jacob tuꞌ? ẍi ix tet Comam.
Istakꞌwican̈ Comam tet ix: —Sunil mac chiucꞌni huneꞌ ha haꞌ tiꞌ chititpaxo istajintiꞌal hunelxa.

Wal mac chiucꞌni ha haꞌ chiwakꞌtiꞌan xin, matxa bakꞌin chitaj istiꞌ, yuto huneꞌ ha haꞌ chiwakꞌtiꞌan lahan hacaꞌ hunu isnukꞌ ha haꞌ chiahilo toptoni cat isbelwi, haꞌ chakꞌni kꞌinale mach istan̈bal tet, ẍi Comam tet ix.
Yalni ix tet Comam xin: —Mamin, akꞌ huneꞌ haꞌ chawal tiꞌ wucꞌuꞌan haxinwal matxa chitaj intiꞌan, matxa chinhulan ikꞌo haꞌ bey tiꞌ, ẍi ix tet Comam.
Yalni Comam tet ix: —As awteti hawichamil cat heyul bey tiꞌ, ẍi Comam tet ix.
—Machi wichamilan, ẍi ix tet Comam. Yalni Comam tet ix: —Caw yel chawala, machi hawichamil.
Yaj howan̈xa ebnaj chawikꞌle, walpaxo naj ikꞌbil hawu tinan̈ xin, mach hawichamilo naj. Yuxin caw yel chawala, machi hawichamil, ẍi Comam tet ix.
Hayet yaben ix huneꞌ tuꞌ xin, yalni ix tet Comam. —Mamin, wal tinan̈, caw chitxumchalo wuhan tato caw ischejab Comam Dios hawehi.

Ebnaj jichmaman̈, haꞌ tiꞌ hulicꞌo ebnaj iswiꞌ huneꞌ witz tiꞌ yikꞌayo isba tet Comam Dios, walexpaxo israelita hex tiꞌ, caw cheyala ta cachann̈echꞌan yul con̈ob Jerusalén chiyu coto jinoyo coba tet Comam Dios, ẍi ix tet Comam.

Yalni Comam tet ix: —Hach ix ach tiꞌ, ayto sunil tzet chiwaltiꞌan yul hawanma. Chiapni huneꞌ istiempohal yet matxa chexhul heyikꞌayo heba tet Comam Dios bey huneꞌ witz tiꞌ, yeb matxa yilalo chextopaxo bey Jerusalén.

Hex ah con̈ob Samaria hex tiꞌ, cheyiyo heba tet Comam Dios heyalni, yaj xin mach heyohtajo Comam, walon̈ Israel on̈tiꞌan̈ xin, johtajan̈ Comam Dios bay chijiyo cobahan̈, yuto coxolan̈ chiel Iscolomal anma.

Wal xin lan̈an yapni istiempohal, haꞌ ton tinan̈, yet chiyinayo isba anma yin̈ istoholal. Caw xin chíyo isba tet Comam Dios yin̈ sunil yanma yeb xin yin̈ caw isyelal, yuto hac tuꞌ choche iscꞌul Comam ta chiyiyo isba anma tet.
Wal Comam Dios, caw Espíritu ye Comam, yuxin macn̈eticꞌa chiyiyo isba tet Comam, caw yilal chiyiyo isba yin̈ sunil yanma yeb xin yin̈ caw isyelal, ẍi Comam tet ix.

Yalni ix tet Comam: —Caw wohtajan tato chul huneꞌ naj Mesías, haꞌ ton Comam Cristo Cocolomal, yu Comam Dios. Hayet chihul naj tuꞌ xin, haꞌ naj chi-cam-halni yin̈ tzet caw yelapno ye sunil, ẍi ix tet Comam.
Yalni Comam xin: —Hanintonan huneꞌ chawal tiꞌ, huneꞌ lan̈an istzotel tawet tiꞌ, ẍi Comam tet ix.

Hayet lan̈an istzotel Comam tuꞌ xin, yapni ebnaj iscuywom. Caw cꞌayilo iscꞌul ebnaj yilni istzotel Comam yeb huneꞌ ix ix tuꞌ. Wal xin caw machi hunu ebnaj kꞌambeni tzet yin̈ xin tzotel Comam yeb ix, yeb xin tzet chal Comam yeb ix.
Lahwi tuꞌ xin, isbejnicano ix istzꞌahab istiꞌ cꞌuh tuꞌ, isto ix yalno tet anma yul iscon̈ob hacaꞌ tiꞌ:
—Catawej, ton̈we jilaꞌ huneꞌ mac mahalni wetan yin̈ sunil tzet wehicojan. ¿Cꞌuxan tato haꞌ naj tuꞌ Cristo? ẍi ix.
Hayet yaben anma huneꞌ tuꞌ, istit anma yilno Comam.
Yet maẍto chiapni anma iscꞌatan̈ Comam, yalni ebnaj iscuywom Comam: —Mam cuywawom, waꞌan̈, ẍi ebnaj tet Comam.
Istakꞌwi Comam tet ebnaj: —Ay huneꞌ tzet chinlohan caw mach heyohtajoj, ẍi Comam.
Yoc ebnaj iscuywom Comam tuꞌ yalno tet hunun hacaꞌ tiꞌ: —¿Tocꞌanab xin ay mac mahulicꞌo akꞌno tzet chislo Comam tiꞌ? ẍi ebnaj.

Yalni Comam xin: —Wal xin, haꞌ tzet choche Comam chejn̈eintijan, haꞌ chiwochehan chinwatxꞌehan, cat xin inlahnihan ismunil akꞌbilcano yul inkꞌaban. Yuxin hayet chinwatxꞌenan ismunil tiꞌ, caw lahan yeb hacaꞌ yet lan̈an inwaꞌan.

Hex tiꞌ cheyala ta can̈ebto ixahaw bay chicꞌuplaxcan̈ ixim trigo. Caw hacticꞌam tuꞌ, yaj chiwalan teyet: ¡Tꞌan̈xan̈wetoj lah, naweloj! Caw maayilo istiempohal iscutxbalaxico anma wetan, hacaꞌ chiyu iscutxbalax ixim trigo yet chikꞌanbilo ixim.

Haꞌ naj chicꞌupnican̈ ixim trigo chischah naj istohol, yechel naj ye naj chiinito anma iscꞌatan̈ Comam yu ischahni iskꞌinal chiyakꞌ Comam. Yuxin naj chitzꞌunni ixim yeb naj chicꞌupnican̈ ixim, lahan istzala iscꞌul ebnaj iscawan̈il.
Hacaꞌ yalni anma chijabe: “Nan naj chitxihni ixim trigo, nanxapaxo naj chicꞌupnican̈ ixim,” ẍi.
Yuxin chexinchejtojan xol anma, hacaꞌ ebnaj chicꞌupnican̈ ixim trigo tuꞌ, nan ebnaj babel munlanahi hacaꞌ yin̈ istxihnayo ixim, hex tiꞌ xin caw toxan̈e chexecꞌ hecꞌupuꞌcan̈ ixim, ẍi Comam tet ebnaj.
Caw txꞌiꞌal anma yul huneꞌ con̈ob ay yul ismajul Samaria tuꞌ chahnicano Comam yul yanma yuto caw wiyom yalni ix hacaꞌ tiꞌ: “Mayalilo naj wetan yin̈ sunil tzet xale inwatxꞌehan,” ẍi ix.
Yuxin hayet yapni anma tuꞌ iscꞌatan̈ Comam, yalni anma tet Comam tato chicancano Comam yul con̈ob tuꞌ. Hac tuꞌ xin yu iscancano Comam cab tzꞌayical bey tuꞌ.
Caw xin hantan̈eto anma chahnicano Comam yul yanma yet yaben iscuywacanto Comam.

Yalni anma tet ix tzotel tet Comam hacaꞌ tiꞌ: —Wal tinan̈, caw chijaytojan̈ yul janmahan̈, yaj maẍn̈etaj yu tzet maxawal jetan̈, to yu han̈-caw-on̈an̈ majabehan̈ tzet chal Comam, yuxinto caw johtajan̈ ta haꞌ Comam tiꞌ Cristo, haꞌ Cocolomal cosunil yul sat yiban̈kꞌinal tiꞌ, ẍi anma tet ix.
Yakꞌ cawxo Comam Jesús iscꞌahol huneꞌ naj chimunla yinta naj rey
Yet islahwi cab tzꞌayic yecꞌ Comam Jesús bey ismajul Samaria tuꞌ xin, isto Comam bey yul ismajul Galilea.
Caw xin halbilxaticꞌa yu Comam tuꞌ tato caw machi hunu ebnaj ischejab Comam Dios xahan chiillax yul iscon̈ob.
Hayet yapni Comam bey Galilea tuꞌ xin, caw cꞌul yu ischahlax Comam yu anma, yuto yil anma tzettaj iswatxꞌe Comam yet yecꞌ kꞌin̈ Pascua bey Jerusalén, yet isbeycꞌo anma yin̈ kꞌin̈.

Yapni Comam Jesús bey yul con̈ob Caná bay elico ha haꞌ vinohal yu Comam. Haꞌ bey yul con̈ob Capernaum xin, ay huneꞌ naj niman yelapno ismunil chimunla yinta naj rey, ay xin huneꞌ iscꞌahol naj caw txꞌoj ye iscꞌul yu yabil.

Yet yaben naj tato tit Comam Jesús bey Judea yapni bey ismajul Galilea tuꞌ, isto naj yilno Comam. Iskꞌanni naj tet Comam tato chito Comam yilaꞌ huneꞌ iscꞌahol naj caw how yehico yabil yin̈, lan̈anxa iscami.
Yalni xin Comam tet naj hacaꞌ tiꞌ: —Wal hex tiꞌ, tato mach cheyil sunil wipan yeb ej cꞌaybalcꞌule chinwatxꞌehan, caw maẍticꞌam chinhechahan yul heyanma, ẍi Comam.
Yalni naj tet Comam: —Mamin, ton̈ yin̈ an̈e yakꞌ isba maẍto chicam incꞌaholan, ẍi naj tet Comam.
Yalni Comam tet naj: —Paxan̈to hawatut, cawxa naj hacꞌahol, ẍi Comam tet naj. Hac tuꞌ yu yanayto naj yul yanma yin̈ tzet yal Comam, ispaxto naj yatut.
Yet ayco naj yin̈ isbel bey con̈ob Capernaum tuꞌ, yapni huntekꞌan ebnaj ismunlawom naj chahwal yin̈ yul beh, yalni ebnaj tet naj: —Cawxa naj hacꞌahol, ẍi ebnaj tet naj.
Iskꞌambenilo naj mame tuꞌ tet ebnaj ismunlawom: —¿Hanicꞌ mawatxꞌilo iscꞌul incꞌaholtuꞌan? ẍi naj. Yalni ebnaj: —Ewitax yin̈ chꞌen hujeb yel kꞌaꞌ yin̈ naj, ẍi ebnaj.

Istxumni naj mame tuꞌ ta hacaꞌticꞌa orahil chal ebnaj ismunlawom naj tuꞌ, hac tuꞌ orahil yet yalni Comam Jesús tet naj hacaꞌ tiꞌ: “Cawxa naj hacꞌahol tuꞌ tinan̈,” ẍi Comam. Hac tuꞌ xin yu ischahnicano naj Comam Jesús yul yanma yeb sunil mac ay bey yul yatut naj tuꞌ.
Haꞌ huneꞌ cꞌaybalcꞌule tiꞌ iswatxꞌe Comam yul ismajul Galilea lahwi isbey Comam yin̈ kꞌin̈ bey Judea. Haꞌ xin iscab cꞌaybalcꞌule tiꞌ iswatxꞌe Comam.
